description:
[writes flayr data · `write` scope] Speaks `text` (max 5,000 characters) in one of your voice clones and returns `audioUrl`. CHARGES EMBERS per 1,000 characters (cloned voices cost more than stock), checked first and charged to the brand's pool; a failed job is refunded. Tell the user the cost before calling. `voiceId` from list_voices (default: your newest clone in the brand).
(Wraps POST /api/v2/generate/voice.)

brandId.description: Brand id, or `personal`. Default: a bound key's brand, else your active brand.

cfgWeight.description: Pacing / adherence knob of the clone voice.

exaggeration.description: Expressiveness knob of the clone voice.

voiceId.description: A voiceId from GET /api/v2/generate/voice. Default: your newest ready clone in the brand.

name: generate_voice
title: Generate a voice-over
